mapper.select: SELECT id, name, genre, difficulty, duration_minutes, min_players, max_players, dm_required, description, created_at FROM scripts ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, genre, difficulty, duration_minutes, min_players, max_players, dm_required, description, created_at FROM scripts WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scripts (name, genre, difficulty, duration_minutes, min_players, max_players, dm_required, description, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{genre}, #{difficulty}, #{durationMinutes}, #{minPlayers}, #{maxPlayers}, #{dmRequired}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
